input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with A credit assessment system is designed to evaluate an individual's creditworthiness and provide a corresponding credit limit. The system aims to make fair and unbiased decisions based on a user's financial history and credit qualifications. It seeks to provide accurate and reliable credit evaluations to help individuals manage their financial obligations.
